heading: INT. ABANDONED LIGHTHOUSE LENS ROOM, MOONLIGHT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED LIGHTHOUSE LENS ROOM, MOONLIGHT - NIGHT
A great Fresnel lens, dark, towering over the room like a cathedral of cut glass.
A rusted catwalk wraps it.
Wind sings through broken panes.
Four people sit on crates in a loose circle, sharing a thermos.
They are strangers by temperament, partners by accident.
CALLISTA ROUSSEL-OKAFOR (30s, field jacket, a laptop open on her knee) taps keys.
DESMOND "DES" ACHTERBERG-NNAMDI (40s, bearded, binoculars at his chest) glasses the sea.
MARIGOLD PEMBERTON-ASANTE (50s, silver hair, birdwatcher's vest) tends the thermos.
And young ZEPHYR KOWALCZYK-ADEYEMI (20s, headphones at his neck, restless) paces the catwalk.
The sea beyond is flat as slate.
The moon is a coin on it.
Tea, anyone?
units.name: MARIGOLD

units.text: Please.
units.name: DES

units.text: Not now.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Nothing yet.
units.name: ZEPHYR

units.text: Always nothing yet, then everything at once.
units.name: MARIGOLD

units.text: She pours.
The steam rises in a thin ribbon.
Callista types.
Des lowers the binoculars.
You're sure of the coordinates?
units.name: DES

units.text: I'm sure of the data. Whoever sent it, less so.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: It's a wild goose chase.
units.name: DES

units.text: It's a boat.
units.name: ZEPHYR

units.text: They all look up.
Zephyr points.
On the black water, a light, small and white, is moving toward the lighthouse.
That's not on the schedule.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: No lights, then lights.
units.name: DES

units.text: Hush. Let it come.
units.name: MARIGOLD

units.text: The boat grows.
A slow engine.
Zephyr descends the catwalk with quick steps.
The four of them gather at the window.
Wind whines in the glass.
The boat slides up to the rocks.
A figure climbs onto the landing.
Thin, soaked, a case in one hand.
He is already climbing the iron stair.
INSPECTOR MALACHI QUARTERMAINE-OSEI (50s, long coat, hat in hand) steps into the lens room, and stops.
He looks at each of them in turn.
Good evening. Thank you for waiting.
units.name: MALACHI

units.text: Callista closes her laptop.
Slowly.
Des lowers his binoculars.
Marigold sets down the thermos.
Zephyr moves, quietly, between the inspector and the stair.
Please. Don't. I'm here as a friend.
units.name: MALACHI

units.text: He sets the case on a crate and opens it.
Inside, a folded sheet of paper and a revolver.
One of you wrote to me. I should like to know which.
units.name: MALACHI

units.text: Silence.
The moon cuts through the lens and throws one blade of light across the floor.
